stories.headline: Paine Launches 2026-27 NBA Elo Forecast and Player Ratings
stories.summary: Analyst Neil Paine has released his 2026-27 NBA season forecasts, featuring updated Elo ratings, game predictions, and LAKER player leaderboards. This year's model introduces fully refitted constants derived from over 77,000 historical game logs dating back to 1946-47. The system utilizes a dual-track memory approach, separating volatile regular-season form from slower-evolving playoff performance metrics.

stories.headline: Paine Drops 2026 NFL Odds Tracker, Elo Ratings, and Player Metrics
stories.summary: Analyst Neil Paine has published his comprehensive 2026 NFL data hub, compiling power rankings, prediction-market odds, and game leverage metrics. The tracker also features team Elo projections alongside specialized quarterback EPA values and in-season Approximate Value player rankings.

stories.headline: Bowles’ ‘Hot’ Blitzes Overwhelm Chicago’s 11 Personnel
stories.summary: Tampa Bay’s defense entered the bye week with the league’s third‑highest overall blitz rate (39%) and fourth‑highest pass‑blitz rate (46%). Bowles relies on single‑high coverage (92nd percentile) and runs “Hot” six‑man blitzes on 35% of early‑down snaps, nearly half of its 44% pass‑blitz rate against 11‑personnel sets. The scheme helped the Bucs intercept Caleb Williams four times, and the NFL is on pace for over 340 Hot blitz snaps in 2026.

stories.headline: 2027 Mock Draft Projects Six QBs in Round One, Yet Jeremiah Smith Remains Unmatched
stories.summary: CBS Sports’ 2027 NFL mock draft envisions six quarterbacks selected in the first round, but the analysts agree none of the prospects can eclipse the talent of Jeremiah Smith. The piece highlights the depth of the quarterback class while underscoring Smith’s perceived superiority.

stories.headline: MKBHD Reviews MacBook Pro LED: Stellar Performance, Not Just Looks
stories.summary: MKBHD calls the new MacBook Pro LED an “incredible laptop,” praising its speed and display while warning viewers not to get distracted by superficial features. The review emphasizes real-world productivity gains over aesthetic hype.

stories.headline: Marques Brownlee Ranks His Favorite Halloween Candy
stories.summary: In a light‑hearted video, Marques Brownlee (Marques Blind) shares his personal ranking of Halloween treats, offering quick commentary on taste, texture, and nostalgic appeal.

stories.headline: Meta Unveils Ultra‑Light Hybrid VR Glasses, a Vision Pro 2 Look‑Alike
stories.summary: Meta introduced a new ultra‑light hybrid headset that blends glasses‑style optics with VR capabilities, drawing comparisons to what a second‑generation Vision Pro might look like. The device aims to deliver a more comfortable, everyday‑wear experience.

stories.headline: Marques’ Studio Spotlights Obscure Foldable Phones
stories.summary: The Studio episode features Marques highlighting a selection of lesser‑known foldable smartphones, explaining their unique designs and why they’ve flown under the mainstream radar.

stories.headline: Basketball Intelligence For 11/15/26
Strategies for Engaging Young Adults in Faith
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition offers resources and essays aimed at addressing the spiritual needs of young adults. The platform provides theological perspectives and practical guidance for church leaders looking to better connect with this demographic.

stories.headline: The Festive Attire We Really Need
England Holds Off Spain in Nations League Thriller
stories.summary: England secured a hard-fought 3-2 victory over world champions Spain to top their group despite playing with ten men in a tense finish. Unlike past collapses against Argentina and Mexico under similar pressure, manager Thomas Tuchel delayed making defensive substitutions, allowing the team to weather the late storm.

stories.headline: Qwen4-Max Released
stories.summary: Qwen4-Max has been announced as the latest technological development in the Qwen ecosystem. Further technical specifics remain tied to the release page.

stories.headline: Steve Blank Examines Nvidia's Next Moves
stories.summary: Industry expert Steve Blank explores the future trajectory of chip giant Nvidia. The analysis touches on broader historical shifts in technology and modern competitive landscapes.

stories.headline: Yemeni Forces Retreat, Handing Red Sea Strait to Houthis
stories.summary: Saudi-backed pro-government forces in Yemen have withdrawn from the vital Bab al-Mandab Strait to reinforce troops around Aden, leaving the strategic shipping lane under Houthi control. The pullout follows months of conflict over the waterway, which disrupted regional oil exports and displaced hundreds of thousands of people.

stories.headline: Reviewing Paul C. Gutjahr’s 'Faith in Space'
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition reviews Paul C. Gutjahr’s book 'Faith in Space,' exploring theological perspectives on extraterrestrial life. The piece is part of the publication's ongoing essays addressing faith, history, and modern cultural questions.

stories.headline: QB, or not QB
Russian‑Ukrainian Drone War Hits Kerch Bridge, 2,049 Drones Shot Down
stories.summary: Russia reported intercepting 2,049 Ukrainian drones and four long‑range missiles in a 24‑hour surge, with a handful striking the Kerch bridge linking Crimea to the mainland, causing minor damage. Simultaneously, Ukrainian forces hit oil refineries and sparked fires, while Kyiv endured a record 17 air‑raid alerts and seven civilian deaths.

stories.headline: UK, Allies Urge Israel to Open Gaza Borders Amid Flood‑Driven Crisis
stories.summary: The UK, Australia, Canada and Italy issued a joint statement demanding Israel allow immediate, unrestricted humanitarian access to Gaza, citing recent floods that damaged tents and left thousands without shelter. Israel claims 93,000 tents and 8,600 aid trucks have entered, but the allies stress that more aid is needed before winter fully sets in.

stories.headline: Tor Project Releases Security Patch for Ongoing DDoS Attack
stories.summary: The Tor Project has rushed out version 0.4.9.17 to address critical relay denial-of-service vulnerabilities involving IPv6 handling. The rapid-response update aims to combat a massive flood of client circuits currently overwhelming network operators.

stories.headline: Aesop Rock and Blockhead Return with 'Trouble Mountain'
stories.summary: Rapper Aesop Rock and producer Blockhead reunite for their second full-length album, leaning into whimsical escapism rather than dense vulnerability. Inspired by childhood resort ads, the project trades dark dread for lighthearted cartography and absurdity.

stories.headline: Week 10 NFL Grades: Vikings Sink Packers as Mahomes Heats Up
stories.summary: The latest NFL report cards highlight a costly division loss for the Green Bay Packers against the Vikings. Meanwhile, Patrick Mahomes delivered a stellar performance to catch fire on the field.

stories.headline: Fly a Biplane Anywhere with WebGL Flight Simulator
stories.summary: Baron is a browser-based flight simulator featuring procedurally generated terrain and authentic biplane mechanics. Players can navigate custom worlds using keyboard, mouse, or touch controls.

stories.headline: Alperen Şengün’s Rise: Could He Eclipse Nikola Jokić?
stories.summary: The Finder’s analysis argues that Houston’s Alperen Şengün has elevated his game enough to challenge Nikola Jokić’s dominance, fueling the Rockets’ second‑best offense in the league. The piece blends subjective opinion with objective metrics, noting the Rockets’ strong adjusted ratings and recent dominant performances.

stories.headline: Estonia to Shut All Russia Border Crossings After Suspected Russian‑Backed Drone Factory Arson
stories.summary: Estonia announced it will close its three road crossings to Russia on Dec. 1, accusing Moscow of directing a sabotage attempt on Threod Systems’ drone plant near Tallinn. Latvian suspects were detained, and officials say the attack was part of Russia’s hybrid war; Moscow called the claim baseless.

stories.headline: 2026 College Football Market Forecasts
stories.summary: Neil Paine provides an updated tracker for the 2026 college football season, featuring aggregated betting odds and win projections. The report also includes quarterback value rankings based on a points-above-replacement metric.

stories.headline: LSU Teeters on Edge of Top 25 as Texas Cements Status
stories.summary: LSU faces the real possibility of dropping out of the college football rankings following recent struggles. Meanwhile, Texas continues to solidify its standing among the nation's elite teams.

stories.headline: John Talabot Drops Dark Pandemic-Era LP
stories.summary: Producer John Talabot returns with Music for Empty Stadiums, a stark departure from soothing lockdown ambient records. Stripping dance music elements of their drums, the album serves as a bracing and anxious portrait of artistic distress.

stories.headline: Trump Establishes New Science and Tech Advisory Council
stories.summary: President Trump has formed the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology via executive order to guide policy on emerging tech like quantum computing and biotechnology. Co-chaired by David Sacks and Michael Kratsios, the high-profile panel features prominent tech figures including Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, and Jensen Huang.

stories.headline: WorkOS Introduces Airlock to Secure AI Agent Permissions
stories.summary: WorkOS has launched Airlock to help organizations manage AI agent tool usage without resorting to dangerous broad permissions or tedious manual approvals. The system evaluates every tool call in real-time against natural language intents and custom security policies.

stories.headline: Vintage Bitly Links in Major Brand and Political Accounts Hijacked
stories.summary: Dormant Bitly shortlinks included in past social media posts by high-profile accounts, including McDonald's, Burger King, and Donald Trump, are being targeted for hijacking. Attackers are weaponizing the abandoned redirects to steer traffic toward malicious destinations or cybercrime operations. The incident highlights the enduring security risks of unmonitored legacy links across prominent social platforms.

stories.headline: Sam Gendel Pivots to Auto-Tune and Trap on New Album
stories.summary: Prolific jazz saxophonist Sam Gendel shocks listeners with Advanced White Trash, a radical stylistic departure. The LP abandons traditional jazz for plasticky synths, trap beats, and medieval-themed Auto-Tuned rap.

stories.headline: Blackhaine Delivers Heavy Noise-Rap on Debut LP
stories.summary: Lancashire rapper Blackhaine explores personal purgatory and heavy trauma on his debut album, Saints in the Wethouse. The project contrasts aggressive, towering production with themes of Catholic suffering and redemption.

stories.headline: Revisiting Pearl Jam's 'Yield'
stories.summary: Pitchfork re-evaluates Pearl Jam's 1998 album 'Yield,' positioning it as the band's most compelling work. The review explores how the album reflects the group's maturation and emotional navigation following the intense fame and personal tragedies of their early career.

stories.headline: Louis van Gaal Shapes Scotland Boss Sebastien Pocognoli
stories.summary: Scotland head coach Sebastien Pocognoli credits legendary manager Louis van Gaal as a major influence on his career. Pocognoli aims to instill that same direct discipline and developmental progress as he navigates a challenging early tenure with the national team.

stories.headline: Plane Crash Survivor Retires With Promotion
stories.summary: Alan Ruschel, one of six survivors from the tragic 2016 Chapecoense plane crash, has retired from professional football after helping Juventude win promotion to Brazil's Serie A. The 37-year-old defender appeared as a late substitute in a 2-0 victory over Botafogo, capping a remarkable comeback from severe spinal and knee injuries. Meanwhile, Juventude's success coincided with the relegation of Chapecoense back to Serie B after a difficult top-flight campaign.

stories.headline: Northern Ireland Reject Draw Mentality in Hungary
stories.summary: Unbeaten and yet to concede a goal in the current Nations League campaign, Northern Ireland need only a draw against Hungary to secure promotion to League A. Despite the favorable math, manager Michael O'Neill's squad insists they will play strictly for a win in Budapest. Players point to a nervy 2022 draw against Luxembourg as a lesson in avoiding complacency when attempting to protect a lead.

stories.headline: OpenAI Unveils ‘ChatGPT Wallet’ Feature
stories.summary: OpenAI introduced a new ChatGPT Wallet, a tool that lets users store and manage digital assets directly within the chat interface. The announcement was posted on the company blog and discussed on Hacker News.

stories.headline: Neil Paine Releases 2026‑27 NHL Elo Rankings and GAR Player Ratings
stories.summary: Analyst Neil Paine published a paid‑subscription post detailing each NHL team’s Elo rating and projected win totals for the 2026‑27 season, alongside a Goals‑Above‑Replacement leaderboard for players. The data, derived from a regressed version of last year’s ratings, is available via a spreadsheet for subscribers.

stories.headline: Army Soldier Files Whistleblower Complaint Over Pentagon’s Iran Drone Strike
stories.summary: A U.S. Army soldier lodged a formal whistleblower complaint alleging that the Pentagon concealed details about an Iranian missile attack that killed six people. The complaint, reported by CNN, raises questions about the military’s handling of the incident.

stories.headline: CBS Sports Predicts Maryland to Defeat Alcorn State in 2026 College Basketball Matchup
stories.summary: CBS Sports’ betting model projects Maryland as the favorite over Alcorn State for their November 16, 2026 game, providing odds and a predicted outcome based on its statistical algorithm. The preview includes time and betting information for the contest.

stories.headline: Why Our Team Switched From AWS Route 53 to a Self‑Hosted Authoritative DNS
stories.summary: A S2 engineering blog recounts the decision to replace Route 53 after hitting API rate limits while trying to support unlimited customer “basins,” each requiring a DNS record. The post explains the performance and consistency challenges that led to building an in‑house DNS solution.

stories.headline: Separate Shootings in Pietermaritzburg and Pretoria Kill 17 in South Africa
stories.summary: Police say eight men were shot dead in a minibus outside Pietermaritzburg and nine people were found slain in a shack in Pretoria’s Jeffsville settlement, with no link between the incidents. Authorities have launched a manhunt amid the country’s ongoing struggle with high murder rates.

stories.headline: Affordability Concerns Propel Childcare to Midterm Election Spotlight
stories.summary: NPR reports that rising living costs made affordability the top issue for voters, boosting childcare policy into the national conversation. Candidates, including New Mexico’s governor‑elect, pledged expanded universal childcare programs as part of their platforms.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang Steps Down as Nvidia CEO After 33‑Year Tenure
stories.summary: Nvidia co‑founder Jensen Huang resigned on Nov 12, 2026, ending a three‑decade run that saw the company evolve from graphics cards to a dominant AI‑chip maker with margins above 70%. His leadership, including the launch of CUDA and the acquisition of Mellanox, positioned Nvidia as the go‑to platform for large‑language‑model training.

stories.headline: Thomas Frank Poised to Take Over Crystal Palace Amid Relegation Battle
stories.summary: Former Brentford and Tottenham manager Thomas Frank is expected to be appointed Crystal Palace head coach as the club sits two points and a goal‑difference behind safety. The move offers Frank a chance to rebuild his reputation after his Tottenham dismissal while Palace hopes to stabilize a squad depleted by recent player sales.

stories.headline: FAA Ground Stop Disrupts Thousands of Flights as Trump Heads to Asia
stories.summary: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy indicated that flight operations could normalize by the end of Monday following a massive nationwide FAA ground stop. The disruption has already caused over 2,300 cancellations and more than 8,000 delays nationwide. Meanwhile, President Trump has traveled to Asia for a high-profile trilateral summit.

stories.headline: Andy Burnham Warns Against Lifting Saturday 3pm TV Blackout
stories.summary: Andy Burnham has urged officials to proceed with caution regarding the potential removal of the UK's Saturday 3pm TV blackout, emphasizing the need to protect lower-league clubs. The rule, enforced since the 1960s under Article 48, prevents matches from being broadcast during peak Saturday hours to encourage stadium attendance. As current broadcast rights deals approach their expiration in the 2028-29 cycle, the future of the blackout remains under scrutiny.

stories.headline: San Diego SNAP Workers Launch Free Grocery Distributions Amid Benefit Cuts
stories.summary: Following federal benefit cuts from the One Big Beautiful Bill that stripped food assistance from roughly five million Americans, social service workers in San Diego are stepping in to help. Employees like Rosa Rodarte are spending their days off organizing free grocery distributions directly outside their county offices. The grassroots effort aims to bridge the hunger gap for local residents struggling with sudden losses in government aid.

stories.headline: FanDuel Offers $200 in Bonus Bets for Chargers-Ravens Monday Night Football
stories.summary: FanDuel is rolling out a promotional offer providing $200 in bonus bets for users wagering on the upcoming Monday Night Football matchup between the Chargers and the Ravens. Sports bettors can access the deal by utilizing the designated FanDuel promo code ahead of kickoff. The promotion targets fans looking to place wagers on the high-profile NFL game.
